DocuRebuild turns scans, photographs and PDF pages into structured documents.
Every imported page keeps its original file unchanged on this device.
Text is extracted locally and stored as a proposal for human review.
Tables can be reconstructed from word boxes or from drawn cell borders.
Figures keep their source crop, caption and an optional reference number.
Equations are typed as LaTeX and rendered offline with KaTeX.
Exports are written locally as Markdown, plain text, Word or PDF.
Version history records checkpoints without replacing the original page.
Project backups are verified before they are offered for download.
The application does not send documents to a remote service by default.
